class.name: FmodBank
class.brief_description: An FmodBank that contains audio information.
class.description: stores fmod audio information. A sound's bank must be loaded before it is played

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the GUID of the bank

method.name: get_loading_state
method.description: The banks current loading state. [b]Note:[/b] Refer to [url=https://www.fmod.com/docs/2.03/api/studio-api-common.html#fmod_studio_loading_state]FMOD_STUDIO_LOADING_STATE[/url]

method.name: get_sample_loading_state
method.description: The audio sample's current loading state. [b]Note:[/b] Refer to [url=https://www.fmod.com/docs/2.03/api/studio-api-common.html#fmod_studio_loading_state]FMOD_STUDIO_LOADING_STATE[/url]

method.name: unload
method.description: Unloads the bank. [b]Warning:[/b] Ignores reference count can lead to bugs if bank is needed elsewhere.

method.name: unload_sample_data
method.description: Unloads non-streaming sample data for all events in the bank.
